special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 17, 2026 for Docon Technologies Pvt Ltd
special_situations.summary: Promoter Docon sold 9.9% stake (~₹986 Cr) via block/bulk deals
special_situations.impact: ~113% of FY26 revenue (₹986 Cr sale vs ~₹876 Cr FY26 revenue); promoter holding cut to 51.02% from 60.92%.
special_situations.risk: Repeated large promoter sell-downs; stock fell ~4.6% on the news
special_situations.view_reasoning: Third major Docon stake sale in ~10 months despite strong Q4 FY26 profit growth; overhang risk vs. institutional absorption.

special_situations.headline: The Board of Directors of the Company has inter alia approved the terms of the Rights Issue
special_situations.summary: Board approved ₹21 Cr rights issue; terms/pricing yet to be finalized
special_situations.impact: ~137% of FY25 revenue (₹21 Cr raise vs ₹15.35 Cr FY25 revenue); market cap only ~₹20-25 Cr
special_situations.risk: Heavy dilution; company has negative operating cash flow, rising debtor days
special_situations.view_reasoning: Revenue growing 53% in FY25 but margins/cash flow deteriorating; raise size vs tiny market cap is highly dilutive.

special_situations.headline: Announcement u/r 30 of LODR-Resignation of CFO
special_situations.summary: CFO resignation disclosed under LODR Reg 30, no reason specified
special_situations.impact: Qualitative only — no deal size involved; company otherwise reported 28% YoY revenue growth in Q1 FY26
special_situations.risk: Reason for CFO exit undisclosed; possible finance-function transition risk
special_situations.view_reasoning: Recent Q1 results strong (revenue up 28%, profit up 15%) with no other red flags found alongside the exit.

special_situations.headline: The Board of Directors at meeting held today i.e., August 19, 2026 has fixed the Record date for the purpose of Rights issue i.e., August 25, 2026
special_situations.summary: Board approved terms of ~₹60 crore rights issue for equity shares.
special_situations.impact: ~281% of FY23 revenue (₹60 Cr raise vs ₹21.35 Cr FY23 revenue); market cap only ~₹22.5 Cr
special_situations.risk: Heavy dilution; weak fundamentals, declining revenue, 41% promoter pledge
special_situations.view_reasoning: NBFC with falling revenue, low 8.54% ROE, pledged promoter stock; large dilutive raise adds risk.

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 19, 2026 for Neelkamal Tower Construction LLP

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received revised Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 19, 2026 for IGE (India) ....
special_situations.summary: Revised promoter (IGE India) share pledge disclosure amid ongoing debt-funded delisting.
special_situations.impact: Part of ₹420 Cr+ debenture-funded delisting; independent directors recommended delisting offer at ₹181.80/share with tendering window Aug 4–10, 2026
special_situations.risk: Promoter pledged up to ~99.64% of holding; high leverage and breach risk
special_situations.view_reasoning: Delisting process well advanced with IDC-endorsed offer price, but extreme promoter leverage remains a red flag.

special_situations.headline: Board at its meeting held today, i.e. on August 19, 2026, has, inter alia considered, approved and fixed the terms of the rights issue including issue price and Record Date.

special_situations.impact: ~147% of FY revenue (₹60 Cr raise vs ₹40.7 Cr revenue; market cap only ~₹23 Cr)
special_situations.risk: Heavy dilution; weak ROE (8.5%), 41% promoter pledge, thin promoter holding (10%)
special_situations.view_reasoning: Raise size dwarfs market cap/revenue; weak NBFC fundamentals and high promoter pledge signal distress-driven capital need.
